status: Complete: all five optimization areas implemented and verified; slower row prototype replaced; final reference, shared-engine and repository checks passed
comparison_protocol: 2048 prompt tokens, 16 output tokens, batch128, 8 threads, F32 arithmetic, CPU, no repack/cache/drafting; F32 and F16 KV cache measured separately; one warmup and one measured pass per version/configuration; preserve all outcomes

items.title: AVX-512 exact Q4_K row products
items.scope: Keep eight rows of scale/minimum parameters in the extra AVX-512 registers while preserving the original four binary64 lanes per row. A separately targeted, CPU/OS-validated unit retains 256-bit arithmetic. The slower pair-packed row prototype is rejected.

items.title: Direct F32 products on existing Q4_K panels
items.scope: Reads the established lossless eight-row quantized layout directly; shares block metadata across input rows and preserves 2048-element reduction boundaries. Existing partial-range fallback and opt-in repack policy remain.

items.title: Selected-block processing pipeline
items.scope: Loads independent row pairs ahead of arithmetic; bounded lookahead prefetches the next selected Q4_K block, never a predicted or unselected expert.

items.title: Scoped physical-core placement
items.scope: Linux chooses distinct cores from the current allowed CPU mask. Worker bindings last for each worker; caller bindings restore on scope exit, including exceptions. Unknown/insufficient topology or other hosts preserve existing scheduler placement.

items.title: Retained conversation prefix checkpoint
items.scope: Existing Mark_Checkpoint reserves slot zero while three recent checkpoints rotate. Generation marks reusable Inkling conversation boundaries through the established policy. No extra checkpoint memory or KV copies; evicted KV history still triggers exact replay. Reset, adoption and invalidation clear the mark.

performance_claim: Observed matched single-pass rates, not a statistical significance claim. Panel measurements are synthetic input tok/s; marked-prefix tests prove zero replay at reachable marked boundaries, not arbitrary evicted-KV reuse.

rejected_row_prototype.reason: Measured 9% slower than the existing AVX2 row product; replaced by resident metadata registers, observed 1.5-2.4% faster across three synthetic shapes in one measured round.

panel_measurement_qualification: The measured direct panel function and compiler target are unchanged in the final source. Its earlier first-trial kernel rates are retained; no fresh final-binary panel timing is claimed.
